verdict.rationale: Orama ships an open-source search library with full-text, vector, hybrid, facets, geosearch and typo tolerance that runs on your own infrastructure. The docs also offer on-premise deployment of the Orama Cloud context server and say the open-source APIs are kept close to Cloud's to ease migration. Feature parity is not shown, though: the open-source AnswerSession depends on the Orama Cloud Secure Proxy, and the MCP server is documented only as part of Cloud projects. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-hosted and hosted, a self-hosted path for the AI answer proxy and MCP server, self-hosting deployment docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
